From the detail.
To the whole building.
settings.name: J & N Joinery Limited
settings.address: 9 Hazelbank Drive, Kilkeel, Co Down BT34 4WG
settings.about: Established as a partnership in 1997, J & N Joinery became incorporated in 2009. Based in Kilkeel, County Down, its published portfolio covers projects across Northern Ireland, Ireland and the UK. The team’s stated capabilities include roofing, cladding panel installation, kitchen and shop fitting, glass and solar panel installation, general joinery, and project management. It works across commercial and public-sector construction, bespoke homes and volume residential developments.
